content.seoTitle: Decor for Bathroom Wall Art Prints | Amalfi Coast Set of 3
content.metaDescription: Transform your bathroom with these dreamy Amalfi Coast wall art prints — coastal Italian scenes in soft blues & whites. Perfect Mediterranean bathroom decor. Free UK shipping!
content.productDescription:
Bring a little of the Italian coast into your bathroom with this gorgeous set of three watercolour-style art prints inspired by the Amalfi Coast. Each print has a loose, painterly quality — soft whites and muted blues washed through with warm terracotta, sage green, dusty pink and earthy neutrals — and together they tell a story of long, lazy lunches by the sea. If you've ever dreamed of a bathroom that feels like a boutique hotel on the Mediterranean, this set of three is the easiest way to get there without leaving home.

The three prints work beautifully as a trio. The left print shows a coastal café table laid with seafood, wine and olives, with sailboats drifting across a pale blue bay in the background. The centre print depicts a charming white-rendered building flanked by tall palm trees — with the handwritten phrase Sotto il sole d'Amalfi (Under the Amalfi sun) inscribed beneath it in delicate script. The right print returns to a sun-drenched terrace scene: a round café table set with a small feast of antipasti, fresh flowers and drinks, with the whitewashed hillside town and shimmering blue sea stretching out behind. The palette is calm and cohesive — soft blue, warm white, touches of coral and green — making all three prints feel like they belong together without being overly matchy.

What's Included with Decor For Bathroom Coastal Mediterranean Wall Art Prints | "Sotto il sole d'Amalfi" | Set of 3

  • A set of 3 individual wall art prints featuring original watercolour-style Amalfi Coast illustrations
  • Printed in the UK using fade-resistant pigment inks for lasting colour that stays true over time
  • Designed for indoor use — ideal for bathrooms, living rooms, hallways and beyond
  • Framed and canvas-wrapped options arrive ready to hang straight out of the box, saving you the time and hassle of hunting for a frame that fits perfectly
  • Choose between unframed and framed options in multiple sizes and in Luster or Museum quality; also available in wrapped canvas size options

How to Style decor for bathroom with This Coastal Set

I'd hang all three in a row at the same height, with an even gap between each print — somewhere around 5–8 cm works nicely and keeps the set feeling intentional rather than random. If your bathroom has a longer wall above the bath or behind the sink, this trio slots in perfectly. The soft blue and white tones play really well with brushed chrome or matt white fixtures, and if you've got any natural wood shelving or rattan accessories in there, the warm terracotta and earthy tones in the prints will pick those up beautifully. For a full Mediterranean mood, pair with white fluffy towels, a terracotta pot or two, and maybe a trailing plant on a shelf.

Not just for bathrooms, though — this set looks wonderful in a kitchen-diner, hallway or even a sitting room. Anywhere you want a little warmth and a holiday feeling, really. For more coastal and Mediterranean wall art ideas, have a browse through our Coastal Wall Art collection — there are some lovely companions to this set in there.

Choosing the Right Size and Finish for Your Space

Before you pick a size, it's worth holding a piece of paper up to your wall (or using painter's tape) to mark out how much space you actually have. For a bathroom, a smaller or medium size per print often works better than going very large — you want the set to feel curated, not cramped. That said, if you have a generous wall above a freestanding bath, don't be shy about going bigger; the detail in these illustrations really rewards a closer look at a larger size.

For finish, I'd genuinely recommend the canvas-wrapped option if your bathroom gets steamy. Canvas is moisture-resistant in a way that paper prints simply aren't, so it holds up much better in a damp, high-moisture environment — it's the practical choice as well as a beautiful one. If your bathroom is well-ventilated or you're planning to hang these in another room, the Luster art paper gives a lovely soft sheen, while Museum quality paper is the one for really rich, true-to-life colour depth.

Scroll down to see how each size looks in a bathroom before you decide — there's a handy size-guide image below showing every available size in a real bathroom setting, which makes the choice so much easier.

aiItems.content:
What is decor for bathroom?

Bathroom decor refers to the decorative items you add to a bathroom to give it personality, warmth and style — and wall art prints are one of the most effective ways to do that. A well-chosen set of prints can make a plain bathroom feel like a considered, designed space rather than a purely functional room. In a coastal or Mediterranean style, soft blue and white tones with painted or illustrative artwork are especially popular, as they create a calm, airy feel that suits the relaxing nature of a bathroom. Choosing prints that are moisture-aware — such as canvas-wrapped options — means your decor stays looking great even in a steamy environment.

How to Hang Decor for Bathroom: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide

1. Choose your wall: Pick a wall with enough clear space for all three prints side by side — above the bath, behind the loo or beside the sink are all great spots. Avoid walls directly above a shower where steam and splashes are most intense.

2. Decide on your layout: For a set of three, a straight horizontal row at eye level is the most timeless arrangement. Mark the centre point of your wall and work outward, leaving an equal gap (around 5–8 cm) between each print.

3. Use a spirit level: Even a small tilt is noticeable with three prints in a row. A small spirit level or a spirit-level app on your phone will save you a lot of re-hanging.

4. Pick the right hanging method: In a bathroom, damage-free adhesive picture strips work well on tiled or painted walls and avoid the need for drilling. For heavier framed options, a single picture hook into a wall stud is the most secure.

5. Step back and adjust: Once all three are up, step back to check the spacing and alignment before you commit. It's much easier to make small adjustments now than after everything is fully secured.

Which Option Is Right for Your Bathroom? Comparing Print Formats

Unframed Print (Luster or Museum paper) — The most affordable option; you choose your own frame. Best for well-ventilated bathrooms or other rooms. Luster paper gives a soft, semi-gloss finish; Museum quality paper delivers the richest, deepest colour reproduction.

Framed Print (Luster or Museum paper) — Arrives ready to hang straight out of the box — no frame-hunting needed. A great choice if you want a polished, finished look immediately. Best suited to bathrooms with good ventilation rather than very high moisture.

Wrapped Canvas — The best choice for damp, steamy bathrooms. Canvas is moisture-resistant, making it far more durable in high-humidity environments than paper prints. Also arrives ready to hang, with the print wrapped neatly around a solid frame — no additional framing required. A beautiful, gallery-style finish.

content.productDescription:
Bring a little of the Mediterranean into your home with these pictures for bathroom walls that feel like a mini holiday every single day. Each of the three watercolour-style art prints captures a sun-drenched coastal dining scene — striped bistro chairs, laden tables with wine bottles and fresh seafood, terracotta pots spilling over with flowers, an olive tree, a glowing lamp post, and sparkling aquamarine sea stretching out to white-washed clifftop villages in the background. The palette is soft and airy: warm whites, gentle sandy tones, aquamarine blues, dusty olive greens, and touches of coral and blush — the kind of colours that make a small bathroom feel calm, bright, and a world away from everyday life.

I genuinely love this set because the loose, sketchy watercolour linework gives it that effortless, well-travelled charm without being fussy or over-styled. Whether your bathroom is all clean white tiles or has a warmer, earthy tone to it, these three prints sit beautifully together. The central print carries the handwritten script Solo d'Amalfi — a lovely little detail that ties the whole set together.

What's Included with Pictures for Bathroom Coastal Amalfi Watercolour Dining Scenes Wall Art Prints | "Solo d'Amalfi" | Set of 3

  • A set of 3 individual coastal watercolour-style wall art prints, printed in the UK using fade-resistant pigment inks for long-lasting colour
  • Suitable for indoor use; designed to brighten bathrooms, toilets, restrooms, and any coastal-themed space
  • The framed and canvas-wrapped options arrive ready to hang straight out of the box — no need to hunt for a frame that fits, which saves you time and hassle
  • Choose between unframed and framed options in multiple sizes and in Luster or Museum quality; also available in wrapped canvas size options

How to Style pictures for bathroom with This Coastal Set

My favourite way to hang this set is in a straight horizontal row, evenly spaced, at eye level — it creates a lovely panoramic coastal feel, almost like you're looking out across three different Amalfi views at once. Keep the gaps between each print consistent, around 5–8 cm works really well. If your bathroom has a long wall above a bath or behind a basin unit, that is honestly the perfect spot. The soft aquamarine tones pick up beautifully on white or off-white tiles, and the sandy warm undertones complement natural stone or wood accents too.

If space is tighter — say, a narrow toilet or cloakroom wall — you can hang all three in a vertical column instead, and they look just as striking. For more coastal and Mediterranean styling ideas, take a browse through our coastal wall art collection for pieces that complement this set beautifully.

Choosing the Right Size and Finish for a Damp Room

Because bathrooms and toilets can get steamy and humid, I always recommend going for the wrapped canvas option if your room sees a lot of moisture — it is the most moisture-resistant choice and will hold up much better over time than a paper print in a very damp space. If your bathroom is well-ventilated, the framed Luster or Museum quality paper prints are gorgeous too and really show off the delicate watercolour detail in these scenes.

In terms of size, think about the wall you have in mind before you choose. A smaller A4 or A3 set works perfectly in a compact toilet or en-suite, while larger sizes make a real statement above a freestanding bath or on a wide feature wall. The aquamarine and white tones in these prints mean they work in almost any sized room without feeling overwhelming — they open a space up rather than close it in. aiItems.content:
What are pictures for bathroom?

Pictures for bathroom are wall art prints specifically chosen to suit bathroom, toilet, en-suite, or restroom spaces — bringing colour, personality, and style to a room that is often overlooked when it comes to decorating. They come in a range of sizes, subjects, and finishes to suit everything from compact cloakrooms to large family bathrooms. For damp or steamy rooms, wrapped canvas prints are a particularly practical choice as they handle moisture better than unframed paper prints. A well-chosen set of bathroom pictures can completely transform the feel of the space, making it feel more considered, relaxing, and even a little luxurious.

How to Hang Pictures for Bathroom Walls: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide

1. Choose your wall: Pick a wall with good visibility — above the toilet, beside the basin, or along a bath wall are all brilliant spots for a set of three prints. Avoid placing prints directly above a shower or bath where they will get splashed.

2. Pick the right finish for your room: If your bathroom gets very steamy, go for the wrapped canvas option — it is the most moisture-resistant. For well-ventilated rooms, Luster or Museum quality paper prints in frames look stunning and show off fine detail beautifully.

3. Plan your layout before you hang: Lay all three prints on the floor first to visualise the arrangement. A horizontal row works brilliantly on wide walls; a vertical column suits narrow walls in toilets or cloakrooms.

4. Mark your positions: Use a pencil and a spirit level to mark where each print will sit. Aim for even gaps of around 5–8 cm between each one for a neat, considered look.

5. Hang and step back: Once all three are up, step back and take a look from the doorway — that is the view most people will see first, and it is the best way to check everything looks balanced and level.

Which Option Is Right for You? Comparing Your Choices

Format — Unframed print: the print only, ready for you to frame yourself. Framed print: arrives ready to hang with no extra framing needed. Wrapped canvas: print stretched over a solid frame, arrives ready to hang.

Best for — Unframed print: buyers who already have a frame or prefer to choose their own. Framed print: anyone who wants a fuss-free, wall-ready result. Wrapped canvas: bathrooms and other rooms with higher humidity or moisture, as canvas handles damp conditions best.

Paper / material — Unframed print: choose Luster art paper or Museum quality paper. Framed print: choose Luster art paper or Museum quality paper. Wrapped canvas: printed directly onto canvas material.

Finish — Unframed print: clean, flat art print with a fine-art feel. Framed print: polished, complete look straight out of the box. Wrapped canvas: slightly textured surface with a contemporary gallery feel.

Moisture resistance — Unframed print: best in dry, well-ventilated rooms. Framed print: best in dry to moderately ventilated rooms. Wrapped canvas: the most moisture-resistant option — our top recommendation for bathrooms and toilets.
